name: Rokunohe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Rokunohe town emblem in white: six rings arranged around a central device.
history: Municipal flag of Rokunohe, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1960.

features.role: Rokunohe town emblem — six rings arranged around a central device
